description: STAT combines precomputed coronal-mass-ejection simulations with energetic-particle transport calculations. It uses CORHEL and EMMREM components to estimate particle fluxes and dose-related quantities for selected events. The resource is documented by Predictive Science; University of New Hampshire. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented workflow depends on precomputed CME simulations; unrestricted event coverage is not established. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
